summary: NAINA OS Volume 5 — Desktop, Mobile & Computer Interaction Framework (DMCIF v1.0). Covers Document 05.1 (Windows Runtime), Document 05.2 (Android Companion), Document 05.3 (Browser Intelligence), Document 05.4 (Application Runtime), Document 05.5 (Hardware Runtime), Document 05.6 (Computer Use Engine), Document 05.7 (Multi-Device Sync), and the flagship Workspace Awareness Engine (WAE).
